feeds.title: Lynnwood Today
feeds.description: Lynnwood Today is a neighborhood news website covering all things Lynnwood, WA. Keep up with all the latest local news and updates.

feeds.title: Lynnwood Times
feeds.description: The Lynnwood Times is Lynnwood's premier news source as well as Lynnwood's only in-print and online newspaper. The Lynnwood Times features informative articles about the local community, residents, arts and culture, city government, history, education, community sports, entertainment and resident conversations.
